campaigns.name: BP · PMax — Outdoor Kitchens
campaigns.rationale: Absorbs Search and Shopping -- PMax serves all channels. Product ads route to product pages via the feed; search text ads and every other placement route to the custom kitchen funnel.
campaigns.critical_setting: FINAL URL EXPANSION MUST BE OFF. Left on, Google sends traffic to whatever page it judges relevant -- including the collection pages we are deliberately removing from paid.
campaigns.tradeoff_noted: Folding Search into PMax gives up SKAG-level control and search-term visibility; PMax reports at asset-group level, not search-term level. Trevor's call, made with that understood.

campaigns.name: BP RT 2: Static Display Remarketing
campaigns.final_url_change: Currently points at betterpatio.com homepage. Repointed to the funnel only.
campaigns.rationale: Best CPA in the account: 6 conversions at ~$25 on $149/mo while starved at $5/day. Raised to $20 and pointed exclusively at the custom kitchen funnel.

campaigns.name: Dynamic Display Remarketing Ads
campaigns.rationale: Kept and optimized. Serves feed-driven dynamic product ads so viewers see the exact products they browsed, landing on product pages.
campaigns.root_cause_found: Currently sends all traffic to the betterpatio.com HOMEPAGE, which is very likely why it has produced ZERO conversions on $291/mo. Switching it to feed-driven product ads is the actual fix, not merely a budget change.

required_negatives.note: Restaurant-contamination negatives are no longer needed -- the grill-brand SKAGs that required them were dropped. Universal negative list still applies (negative_keywords/betterpatio.json).

landing_page_policy.model: Three campaigns. PMax serves all channels -- products via feed, everything else to the custom kitchen funnel. Static remarketing -> funnel only. Dynamic remarketing -> product pages via feed. Nothing points at collections or the homepage.
landing_page_policy.funnel_url_source: VERIFIED — live final URL on 'Build Your Own Outdoor Kitchen Campaign', the account's only converting campaign.

cutover_plan.critical: The account currently has 12 ENABLED campaigns totalling $392/day in budget capacity. Launching the new build without pausing them would leave the account at $542/day and put new campaigns in direct competition with old ones on the same keywords and the same product feed.
cutover_plan.rule: Every campaign below is paused in the SAME operation that enables its replacement. Never both live at once.

disposition.campaign: Build Your Own Outdoor Kitchen Campaign
disposition.note: The account's only converting Search campaign, so this is the one carrying real risk. The replacement targets the SAME funnel with proper SKAG structure, so running both would mean bidding against ourselves on identical kitchen terms. If Trevor prefers caution, the alternative is to leave this live for 2 weeks and launch the SKAG campaign alongside at reduced budget -- accepting some self-competition in exchange for not interrupting the one thing that works.
